Notifications are set up once in Pulse and every app sends through it. The indexer catalog tests sites in the background and recommends the ones that work, searches fall back to an indexer's mirrors, and Pulse now hands download-client passwords and Haul's key to Pilot and Prism. The live event stream works for the first time.

**Access.** Pulse now has one Security setting, the same in every Beacon app: no login (the default: your local network gets in, connections from anywhere else are refused), login from outside your network, or login for everyone. If Pulse sees your devices under an unusual address, list the range in Settings or in `PULSE_AUTH_LOCAL_NETWORKS`.

**Upgrading.** Until now Pulse let in any request that carried one browser header, from any address. The apps reach Pulse with its API key and are unaffected; if you open Pulse from outside your network, set a login first (Settings → App Settings → Security). Pulse no longer prints its API key in the log.
